ETH Activity Strong Despite Price Weakness
CryptoQuant data noted a growing divergence between Ethereum’s price performance and underlying network activity.
Despite ETH retreating from highs above $4,500 to almost $2,500, daily active addresses have largely remained between 350,000 and 500,000, recently standing near 337,600.
Meanwhile, deployed smart contracts increased from around 60 million in January to more than 72 million by October 2026.
The sustained expansion suggests developers continue building on Ethereum despite market volatility and weaker token prices.
